media.title: Nacio Herb Brown at the piano — Photoplay, October 1929
media.description: Nacio Herb Brown at a piano in a promotional photograph with Anita Page for The Hollywood Revue of 1929, published in Photoplay in October 1929. The local portrait is cropped from the full source image. Brown’s songs were among the contemporary American repertory arranged by Kaper in Berlin.
media.altText: Black-and-white portrait detail of composer Nacio Herb Brown seated at a piano in a raincoat and hat.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in the United States. The complete photograph was published in Photoplay, volume 36, no. 5, October 1929, p. 100; Wikimedia Commons applies its public-domain designation for United States works published before 1 January 1931. Copyright status may differ in jurisdictions that do not apply the rule of the shorter term to United States works. The local image is cropped to Nacio Herb Brown, at right in the source photograph; no alteration beyond cropping and file-format conversion has been made.
